open_questions.text: Owner references still unidentified or unverified: is github.com/jeantimex/tokyo the owner's Tokyo post? What is Bay Atlas's real stack (MapLibre + PMTiles + Mapzen terrain + OSM is unverified; no repo was found)? The Lombard Street exhibit and traffic demo are still unidentified; the owner would need to supply the links.

open_questions.theme: References and tools that could not be verified here
open_questions.text: Game wiki maps (Fextralife, MapGenie and similar Leaflet CRS.Simple sites): no fetchable primary source showed how they register city or underground sub-maps into the world frame. Only Leaflet's CRS.Simple tutorial was verified (VL13).

open_questions.theme: References and tools that could not be verified here
open_questions.text: Tooling unknowns, moot unless a build step or plugin is ever allowed: no-SRS gdalwarp with atlas world px (y down) as target — what sign does the output geotransform's y axis get, and is negating y needed (not run)? Could Allmaps' renderer work on CRS.Simple with an identity or custom proj4 definition (Viewport and WarpedMapList hard-default to Web Mercator; not tried)? Is there a primary source for leave-one-out validation in a georeferencing tool (gdal.org, docs.qgis.org, allmaps.org and pro.arcgis.com were egress-blocked; only a search snippet)? Is Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated's nested-div technique correct under Leaflet 1.9.4 zoomSnap 0 fractional flyTo and under pinch zoom (needs a browser test, not allowed in this job)?

open_questions.theme: Gaps in the check record
open_questions.text: Truncated dissents: the failing-check objections for G0-2, G0-5, G0-10, G0-13, G0-15, G8-1, G8-2, G8-3, G8-7, G8-11, G9-2, G9-8, G7-6 and G7-9 are cut off in the only record, as are those for canon C02 and C21, reg R8, gap-mobile C4, and the disputed R6, C06, tc-2, tc-8, G7-13 and others marked 'truncated' in the sections, so their exact objections are not known. G0-13's objection appears to concern the 7-10 POI displacement figures, and G8-7's may concern whether a runtime mask may read the cached MASKQ[key].m without editing the pinned function.

owner_questions_raw: Approve the anchor verdict table: 45 move, 2 keep (Drāmūz, where the marker is the wrong record and gets fixed; Sjefenhold, an uncharted canon place kept with an explicit off-dot reason), and 4 owner calls (Paga, Penthelon, Ūmak-nūs-Ion, Kolens). The table would be derived by an offline tool against a reviewed by-name exception table, with no runtime marker-wins rule and no distance-only snap.

Which point convention governs the anchor table and the cityCanvasSha B0 re-cut: ring centre (pixel-centre detector), census-marker convention (ring −(1,0)), or today's anchor convention (ring −(1,1))? G0-3 makes this a precondition: each choice gives a different mask window, plan and hash, and changes Tamaron's sea approaches.
Approve an owner-approved cityCanvasSha B0 rebaseline for Tamaron, Sokundo and Kanae (anchors, sea.side and road bearings). Should it land at the Mobile 9 lane boundary or as a declared rebase?

Penthelon: moving it onto its printed ◉ drowns the plan, because the r−b≤54 mask reads the region tint as water. Move it with a different land/water source (inked coast or DEM, which touches the pinned sampleCityMask path), or keep it off-dot with a fresh reason? Paga: re-snap both its anchor and its marker to the printed ○ near (2074,809)?

Summarch: move the literal (523,58) to the printed ◉ (about 542,50) as a translation only, keeping FOOT_R 14 and north-up. Should the factions.json Allhammers seat and the party-route.json (523,58) waypoint move with it? The second visit at (545,80) is offset on purpose.

Epēshu placement policy: which scale in about 0.6x-1.0x, and which chart point sits on the ring? The print coast favours 0.6x+3E (3.58 rms). The sim's label spread and extent favour about 1.0x or more. Confirm that the atlas wins for placement and the sim follows later as a separate item.

Epēshu seam band 2 (chart sea over print land, about 75 px² at 0.6x+3E): make it transparent, key the chart's flat sea fill out to show atlas land, or fill it with land tone? Band 1 is handled by the print-land clip plus a sea fill in pCityWash.

Lifecycle policy: may worldCityUpdate stop lowering maxZoom below the current zoom (no automatic ease-down), with catchment hysteresis? This changes desktop feel, and the living chart's H2z zoom-through builds on it.

Who owns the new registration work: the per-city record, the print-coast ring and sea fill, the plan-river consumer, and road re-traces with a per-leg medium field in party-route.json? Today none of these is owned by the filigree, living, street or mobile tracks.

Re-trace the Road that Walks with the Sun and the sea-lane vertex [1320,1398] onto the printed ink now (data-only, but it changes generated gates and cityCanvasSha), or wait for POLISH 'Traced road network'?

Epēshu scale policy. The print coast favours about 0.6x of today's box with the centre +3 px E (3.58 atlas px rms). The sim's hand-placed labels favour about 1.0x, and the sim's built-up extent favours 1.0x or more. The atlas decides placement and the sim follows. Which scale in roughly 0.6-1.0x, and which chart point sits on the printed ring (Forum, harbour mouth, built-up centroid)?

Summarch: approve a translation-only move from (523,58) to the printed ring (541.75,49.75), applied in meshedWorldInit, factions.json (Allhammers seat) and party-route.json, keeping FOOT_R 14 and north-up? The DM's river runs north of the ring and the atlas river runs on the other side. Redraw the river, move the ring, or accept the mismatch?

Penthelon: its marker sits on the printed ◉, but moving the anchor there drowns the plan because the colour test reads the olive region tint as water. Move it together with a non-colour land/water source (which touches the UG3-pinned sampleCityMask), or keep it off-dot?
Drāmūz: fix the marker, which is 35 px S in open water, and keep the anchor? Paga: re-snap both records to the printed ○ near (2074,809)?
The other owner calls and keeps: Kolens (uncharted, no printed river or ring under it), Ūmak-nūs-Ion, and Sjefenhold (keep off-dot with an explicit reason)?

Point convention, needed before any B0 recapture: ring centre, census marker ring-(1,0), or anchor convention ring-(1,1)? Each gives a different sampleCityMask window, cityCanvasSha and gate set (Tamaron sea [319.3,1.6] against [317.7,113.6,3.5]).

Approve a cityCanvasSha B0 rebaseline for the hashed trio at Tamaron ◉ (1659,1554), Sokundo ○ (1478,1450) and Kanae ○ (1523,1490), with their sea fields re-measured in the same edit? Should it land at the Mobile 9 lane boundary?
Which mile constant governs: the printed bar (659 atlas px = 600 mi, 0.910 mi/px) or MI_PER_NATIVE=600/723 (0.830, undocumented)?

Who owns the per-city registration record, the clip data and a skeleton trace? The proposal is a new atlas POLISH item beside filigree slice C, with no density-bible edit. A full-building trace would be a separate item.
Should sim adoption of chart geometry for Epēshu (a whole-world #s=epeshu re-baseline through W.rng.gen) be a separate owner-gated item after the street hold?
Epēshu seam band where chart sea lies over print land (about 75 px² at 0.6x+3E): make it transparent, fill it with land tone, or keep the base opaque under the footprint?
Does the DM hold higher-resolution or vector masters (for example a Watabou MFCG export) for Epēshu and Summarch?

Q1 (restated with G0-18): the DM raster is 1 texel per CSS px at Epēshu's cityMaxZ 9.885, so on phones it goes soft from z8.3 (DPR 3) to z8.885 (DPR 2) and flyIntoCity lands at 0.471 texels per device px on an iPhone 13. Is the goal crispness (a higher-resolution registered raster would do), or a drawn, interactive city: a vector layer replacing the chart, under it as hit geometry only, or only past its native zoom?

Q3 (with G7-10): the city has nothing at rest (R7), no block labels (R4) and a 22 CSS px tap resolver (FM4). Should it carry building or block hit-testing at all? If yes, as a coordinate lookup through the registration transform, or as vector paths? Note that the prototype's drawTrace draws POI discs at rest, which R7 forbids.

Q4 (with G0-15 and G7-12): the scale of Epēshu's chart has two conflicting criteria. The print coast favours about 0.6x+3E; the sim's labels favour about 1.0x and its extent at least 1.0x. The atlas wins for placement, so pick within about 0.6-0.8x and the sim follows. Separately, the chart's drawn density cannot match the sim's metric lots (about 4-7x linear). Is the atlas fabric a symbolisation with no metric scale?

Q9 (with G0-2 and G0-3): approve a cityCanvasSha B0 rebaseline for Tamaron, Sokundo ○ (1478.0,1450.0) and Kanae ○ (1523.0,1490.0). First rule which point convention (ring centre, ring-(1,0) or ring-(1,1)) anchors use, because it changes the sampleCityMask window and the hash.

Q11: confirm LC7 (the sim is the only 3D; no WebGL in maps-site; H2z crossfades into a Street poster). If confirmed, any vector city is a 2D Leaflet layer and the prototype's three.js mode stays out of the atlas.

Q12 (G7-11 and G0-21, an inference): no track owns an atlas vector city. Should the canon skeleton trace (coast/water, Summarch's wall, Epēshu's hinterland edge) be split into the anchoring/registration item, with a full-building or chart-conditioned fabric as its own later item gated on Q1/Q18?

Q16 (G7-13): should the sim ever adopt chart geometry for Epēshu? It would re-baseline the whole #s=epeshu world (buildings, great houses, flora, chronicle), not just Epēshu. Keep the sim out of the first cut?

Q18 (V17, G0-20): both canon charts look like Watabou MFCG output. Does the DM hold the MFCG seeds/permalinks or GeoJSON exports for Epēshu and Summarch? Ask before any tracing. Tracing finds no street network in the charts (lanes are unpainted ground).

Canon art bending: may the DM's Epēshu and Summarch charts be rotated to the atlas (Helmert keeps shapes, but it needs a PNG or WebP pre-warp with alpha, or a custom overlay subclass), or warped (TPS or polynomial2/3)? Or is scale plus translate (new axis-aligned bounds, no resampling) the limit?

Should the modal chart (enterChart over charts/epeshu and charts/summarch) read the same stored chart-px-to-atlas-px transform, for example so Back returns to the registered spot? Or should it stay in its own chart-px frame, which leaves two POI transforms?

Should the registration audit (a swipe or opacity override with base and overlay forced to opacity 1, at about z7-8) ship behind a URL debug flag in maps-site, or stay tools-only? R7 forbids showing it at rest.

Epēshu placement policy (cross-reference): which chart pixel sits on the printed ring-dot, and which scale in the 0.6x-1.0x range? Coast shape cannot decide it: a free fit runs to the edge of its search box.

Is the living track's H2/H2z link allowed new atlas hash keys for view state (an atlas-px centre plus a scale)? Today setHash writes only #place= and #chart=, and the sim's applyGotoFromHash reads only a name.

Q8 (corrected): approve the anchor verdicts as 45 move, 2 keep, 4 owner calls (Paga, Penthelon, Ūmak-nūs-Ion, Kolens) rather than 37/1/2. Confirm the two meanings of 'keep': Drāmūz (anchor right, marker fixed) and Sjefenhold (uncharted place kept off-dot with a reason). Treat Hordon and Clickerhall as anchor errors, not exemptions.

Q9 (extended): rule the point convention first (ring centre, marker, or anchor at ring-(1,1)) and whether the trio's sea fields are re-measured or frozen. Then approve one cityCanvasSha B0 re-cut for Tamaron, Sokundo and Kanae at the Mobile 9 boundary.

Q12 (refined): should a standalone atlas registration item own the per-city record, the anchor data and the seam-clip data, reaching Filigree 2 through a README §7 row? Should the canon skeleton trace sit with it, and a full-building trace be its own owner-gated item? Is holding Street 3 (a 'Filigree data —' title) wanted?

Q4 (extended): the Epēshu scale has two conflicting criteria. The print coast favours 0.6x+3E (3.58 rms, at the edge of the search box); the sim's label spread and extent favour about 1.0x or more. The atlas wins for placement and the sim follows. Which scale in 0.6x-1.0x?
Q11 (reframed): LC7 asks only about 3D/WebGL in maps-site. Should a 2D in-atlas detailed city be built at all, and how does it relate to the H2z crossfade source (today 'the city overlay')?

Q16 (narrowed): move the sim's Epēshu cityLabels toward the registered chart POIs before Street 1 (costs fixtures SV1/SV3/SV6/SV8, not the fingerprint), and leave planStreetsFor alone until an LC17-class ruling?
Q6 (extended): when Summarch's literal (523,58) moves to its printed ring, do factions.json (Allhammers seat), party.json and party-route.json move with it?

New: should the sim adopt the chart's canon district spellings ('Marble Quarter', 'Thūkīn Amphitheatre', 'The Fairy Arch')? Should 'Sim ↔ atlas continuity' add cityLabels targets to #goto= so that LC7's 'Epēshīn Forum' step lands?
New: use the Blue Temple of Thobrauk / Wood Quay pair as the first Epēshu control point (the sim would have to place the temple first for it to be shared)?
New: the setMaxZoom ease-down in worldCityUpdate is an unrequested camera move that nobody owns. Should it ride with the registration item's lifecycle fixes?
measure_probes_raw: Common setup, in a later session after Mobile 5 lands and never beside a mobile capture. Profiles: desktop 1366x768@1, desktop2x 1440x900@2, iphone13 390x664@3 touch (pixel7 where noted). Load http://localhost:8544/maps-site/?v=<fresh-int> and wait for window.ATLAS.ready.

P1 setMaxZoom ease-down (desktop, iphone13): ATLAS.descend('Kanae'), wait for moveend, then ATLAS.map.panBy([1800,0],{animate:false}). Repeat with a drag at z9 from Epēshu into open sea. Log getZoom(), getMaxZoom(), getCenter() and a timestamp on every zoomend/moveend for 3 s. Fail on any zoom change >0.05 without input. Expected today: about 2.3 dz (Kanae) and 1.885 (Epēshu).

P2 synthetic-to-melded swap (desktop, iphone13): with cache disabled, load #chart=Sokundo&poi=1. Per rAF, log getZoom(), the count of '.leaflet-pCity-pane img' and ATLAS.cityReg['Sokundo'].url. Record the POI latlng at fly start against worldPOICoord after landing. Take overlay-only shots before and after the swap. Report the POI move in atlas and screen px and the coast rotation in degrees.

P4 crossfade residuals (desktop, iphone13): centre on Epēshu (1236.1,1415), Summarch (542,50 and the literal 523,58), Sokundo and Damoklir at z7.1, 7.3, 7.5, 7.8 and at each city's cityMaxZ. Take one shot with pCity and pCityWash hidden and one with the tile pane hidden. Pick coast and road edges and report chamfer rms/max in screen px and in atlas px (divide by 2^(z−4)). Static estimate for Epēshu: about 7.7-8.5 atlas px rms. Target after registration ≤2 screen px at z7.3.

P5+ Hordon/Maeges end state (desktop): load #chart=Maeges cold. For 6 s log getZoom(), getMaxZoom(), the overlay src, and every setView call via a wrapper, so the ensureArrival retries at 1.7, 3.4 and 5.1 s show up. Expected: a 2.33 dz yank to 8, Hordon's plan appearing, then an unanimated snap to about 10.19. With Hordon pre-registered: a 0.14 ease only.

P6 exitChart clamp (desktop 1200x800): at fitZoom record getCenter(), then ATLAS.chart('Epēshu') and ATLAS.exitChart(). Repeat with 'Seat'. Log the centre after zoomend. About 1113 atlas px east today; pass ≤1 px. Also exit then ATLAS.fly('Kanae') and log whether the fly completes.

P7 mid-fly mask callback (desktop, iphone13): cold cache, ATLAS.descend('Sokundo') from the fit view. Per rAF log getZoom(), getMaxZoom() and the '.leaflet-pCity-pane img' count. Fail if the count drops to 0 mid-fly.

P8 ensureArrival hijack (desktop, iphone13): ATLAS.descend('Epēshu'), then inject a synthetic drag at t=300 ms. Log moveend times and zoom at 1.7, 3.4 and 5.1 s. Fail on any jump after the drag. Expected today: a single teleport of about 4.7 levels.

P9 #view boot cap (desktop, settles the disputed view-hash-lossy): load cold #view=1236,1415,9.5, then #view=542,50,10.5, then a generated ruin at 11. Log getMaxZoom() inside the first worldCityUpdate (before handleHash) and after landing, plus the landed zoom and centre against the request. This decides whether every link deeper than 8 lands at 8 (Epēshu included) or Epēshu keeps 9.885.

P10 generation jank (pixel7, iphone13 at 4x CPU throttle): scripted pinch onto an ungenerated town with a PerformanceObserver('longtask'). Report the count and duration of tasks >50 ms. Also time the overlay 'load' of overlay-Epeshu.jpg on Fast 3G against getZoom(); that part belongs to A-U11.

P12 retina base dropout (desktop2x, iphone13): at z>10.5 over a village, a ruin and Summarch, log the base tile layer's visible tile count and opacity during zoom, and screenshot the plan and wash edge.

P13 seam both signs after registration (desktop, iphone13): once a per-city record exists, at z7.3 and 9.885 over Epēshu, measure land-over-sea and sea-over-land area of the overlay against the print water mask (static at 0.6x+3E: 91 and 75 atlas px²). Pass when both bands are hidden by the chosen clip or fill.

P14 clip-path on a Leaflet ImageOverlay (G8-9; iphone13, pixel7, desktop): apply a % clip-path: polygon() from the print-land ring to the Epēshu overlay img through the className option. At z7.3 and 9.885, check there is no hairline at the clip edge, that both seam bands are hidden, and that the clip tracks the img through a button zoom (CSS transform) and through flyIntoCity (per-frame _reset). Record frame times during the fly with and without the clip.

P15 river crossings (desktop): for the 18 generated plans with a printed river within 2.5·FOOT_R (G0-7), shoot at z7.8 and cityMaxZ with pCity shown and hidden, and record whether the plan hides or contradicts the printed river. Repeat after any anchor move.

G8-9 clip probe. Later session, after Mobile 5, never alongside a mobile capture. Profiles: iphone13 390x664@3 touch, pixel7, desktop 1366x768@1. Load http://localhost:8544/maps-site/?v= and wait for window.ATLAS.ready. Apply a throwaway percent clip-path polygon (the islet-filled print-land ring at DP0.5) to the Epēshu pCity via a class. Centre on (1236.1,1415) at z7.3 and z9.885. Screenshot with the tile pane hidden and with the pCity pane hidden. Check that land-over-sea is hidden, that there is no hairline at the clip edge, and that the clip holds during ATLAS.descend('Epēshu'). Log rAF frame times during the fly and compare them with an unclipped run.

P13 seam areas once a per-city override exists (desktop, iphone13). At z7.3 and 9.885 over Epēshu, measure overlay land-over-sea and sea-over-land against the print water mask in screen px, then divide by 2^(z-4). Static targets at 0.6x+3E are 91 and 75 atlas px². Pass when the chosen clip and fill hide both bands.

G8-4 fill tone. At 0.6x+3E, with the clip and a sea-toned L.imageOverlay in pCityWash at zIndex 2, sample screen RGB inside the clipped band 1 and compare with the print sea mean [159,152,117]; target ΔE well under the measured wash 14.1. Repeat after a forced washRefresh to confirm the fill stays above the wash.

P4 crossfade residuals in screen px (desktop, iphone13). Visit Epēshu (1236.1,1415), Summarch at both (541.75,49.75) and the literal (523,58), Sokundo and Damoklir. Shoot each at z7.1, 7.3, 7.5, 7.8 and at the city's own cityMaxZ, once with pCity/pCityWash hidden and once with tiles hidden. Report coast and road chamfer rms/max in screen px and in atlas px. Static Epēshu baseline: 8.48 atlas px ≈ 84 screen px at z7.3.

P11 vector cost, only if a vector form is chosen (iphone13, pixel7, desktop). Build a throwaway page with N = 300 / 1,000 / 3,000 and 5,000-30,000 features (1.9k-30k vertices). Compare SVG merged by class (11-30 paths, fillRule nonzero) against L.canvas({pane:'pCity'}), with smoothFactor 0 and the default. Run a flyIntoCity-like flyTo and a pinch. Time animation frames and the single end-of-gesture long task separately, at z7.8 and at the city's cityMaxZ.

G7-10 build time on a phone (pixel7 and iphone13, also at 4x CPU throttle). Run the chart-conditioned Epēshu build (growRibs, extractBlocks, makeParcels, footprint) under PerformanceObserver('longtask'). Node v22 measured about 1.2 s. Decide between static output and building once off the gesture path.

Era check (desktop). Switch setEra among modern, war and imperial with the Epēshu overlay and clip at z7.8. Confirm the overlay, clip and POIs do not move. Record the wash tone mismatch on war and imperial (expected ΔG≈29, ΔB≈21 in Leponnia) as a colour item, not a registration item.

P11 vector cost (later session after Mobile 5, never beside a mobile capture; profiles iphone13 390x664@3 touch, pixel7 at 4x CPU throttle, desktop 1366x768@1). Build a throwaway page with Leaflet 1.9.4 CRS.Simple. Load synthetic city layers of 700 / 1,000 / 2,100 / 6,279 / 7,758 features at 2.6k / 8.5k / 23k / 29k vertices. Draw each two ways: SVG merged by class (9-30 L.polygon multipolygons, 3-level arrays, fillRule:'nonzero') and L.canvas({pane:'pCity'}). Run a flyTo from z6 to z9.4 and a scripted two-finger pinch.
